text:
Palladium Price in 2002
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2002, the LBMA palladium price fell 36.2% between 2002-01-31 ($370) and 2002-12-30 ($236). The highest sampled price was $386 in March and the lowest was $236 in December. The mean of these observations was $328. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
